title: Wartime Bus Stops & Gas Lines
summary:
*   **Wartime Bus Route Changes:** To conserve gasoline and tires during the war, bus stops were authorized to be eliminated or changed on a trial basis, fulfilling a federal request for resource conservation.
*   **New Gas Lines Approved:** Permits were issued for the installation of gas mains across several city streets, detailing construction guidelines and utility coordination.
*   **Govalle Residents Request Bus Service:** Citizens advocated for new daily bus service to the Govalle neighborhood, prompting the city to explore re-routing an existing line that served the Del Valle Air Base.
